name: Two-tone Print
description: An image reduced to dots, lines or noise in two colours, like a woodblock or newspaper print.

props.name: src
props.description: The image. Any URL or data URI the browser can draw on a canvas; remote images need CORS headers.

props.name: alt
props.description: Describes the picture. The root is an image for assistive technology.

props.name: gridSize
props.description: Size of one dither cell in pixels. Halftone dots and hatching scale with it.

props.name: mode
props.description: Ordered 8×8 matrix, round dots on a 45° screen, scattered noise, or engraved diagonal hatching that crosses and doubles in the darker tones.

props.name: colorMode
props.description: Duotone prints in the two colours. Grayscale uses their lightness only. Original gives each dot the picture's own colour on the paper colour.

props.name: primaryColor
props.description: The ink. Indigo ink by day, pale water at night.

props.name: secondaryColor
props.description: The paper. Snow by day, night blue at night. When the ink is lighter than the paper, dots stand for light instead of shadow, so the picture keeps its tones in either theme.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Raise for fewer dots, lower for more.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Added to the picture's lightness before dithering, from -1 to 1.

props.name: contrast
props.description: Stretches the picture's lightness around the middle before dithering.

props.name: invert
props.description: Swaps light and dark in the picture.

props.name: animated
props.description: Shifts the pattern slowly across the picture. Stops with reduced motion and while off screen.

props.name: objectFit
props.description: How the picture fits the box. Contain leaves paper around it.

props.name: className
props.description: Size the root with classes, for example aspect-[16/10] w-full. Other props go to the root element.
